definitions.explanation: A person who worships a deity, religious figure, or spiritual entity. Used in religious and historical contexts.
A person who deeply admires or reveres another person, ideology, or movement. Can carry a slightly intense connotation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{崇拝者|すうはいしゃ}たち。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{神殿|しんでん}→神殿：18822_shinden⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{崇拝者|すうはいしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: Many worshippers gathered at this temple.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古代|こだい}→古代：05324_kodai⟧エジプト⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、ファラオ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{神|かみ}→神：02147_kami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{崇拝者|すうはいしゃ}⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{同時|どうじ}→同時：01592_douji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{神|かみ}→神：02147_kami⟧⟦そのもの→そのもの：27432_sonomono⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In ancient Egypt, the pharaoh was regarded as both a worshipper of the gods and a god himself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{若|わか}い{頃|ころ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{哲学者|てつがくしゃ}→哲学者：23941_tetsugakusha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{崇拝者|すうはいしゃ}で、⟦{全|ぜん}→全〜：28337_zen⟧⟦{著作|ちょさく}→著作：18234_chosaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読破|どくは}した→読破する：20895_dokuhasuru⟧。
examples.english: She has been a devotee of that philosopher since she was young and has read all his works.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{崇拝|すうはい}→崇拝：10032_suuhai⟧ ('worship; adoration') and ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ ('person'). The word can describe both literal religious worshippers and secular admirers, though in either case it implies a deep, almost reverential level of devotion.

USAGE:
In modern usage, the secular sense (sense 2) can carry a faintly negative nuance, suggesting uncritical or excessive admiration. In religious and historical contexts (sense 1), it is neutral.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {熱烈|ねつれつ}な{崇拝者|すうはいしゃ}: ardent admirer
- {偶像|ぐうぞう}{崇拝者|すうはいしゃ}: idol worshipper
- ⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{崇拝者|すうはいしゃ}: sun worshipper
- {崇拝者|すうはいしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧: worshippers gather

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧: fan — a casual, positive term for a supporter or enthusiast; no religious overtone
- ⟦{信者|しんじゃ}→信者：11565_shinja⟧: believer; follower — primarily religious; can also be used sarcastically for a blind follower
- ⟦{愛好者|あいこうしゃ}→愛好者：29205_aikousha⟧: enthusiast; lover of — neutral term for someone who enjoys a particular hobby or pursuit
- ⟦{崇拝|すうはい}→崇拝：10032_suuhai⟧: worship; adoration — the act itself, without the person suffix
